   \sum_{p \in P} w_p \cdot x_{sp} \leq c_s

   \[
   x_{sp} \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}

    for rec in [r for r in data['tables'] if r['table_id'] == shelf_table_id][0]['records']:
        shelf_id = rec['values']['ShelfID']
        S.append(shelf_id)
        c_s[shelf_id] = float(rec['values']['Capacity'])
    P = []
    v_p = {}
    w_p = {}
    for rec in [r for r in data['tables'] if r['table_id'] == product_table_id][0]['records']:

        P.append(product)
        v_p[product] = float(rec['values']['Value'])
        w_p[product] = float(rec['values']['Weight'])
    if set(c_s.keys()) != set(S):

    m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((v_p[p] * x[s, p] for s in S for p in P)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    m.optimize()
    return m
